<p class="eyebrow">Reliable low-rank computation for multiscale PDEs</p>

# Shiheng Zhang

<p class="hero-role">Pearson Fellow and Acting Instructor, Department of Applied Mathematics, University of Washington</p>

<p class="hero-summary">I develop reliable low-rank numerical methods for multiscale PDEs, combining geometric time integration, asymptotic-preserving discretization, and structure-preserving analysis so reduced models remain stable and accurate in stiff or nearly rank-deficient regimes.</p>

::: {.hero-tags}
`Dynamical low-rank approximation`
`Multiscale PDEs`
`Kinetic equations`
`Structure-preserving methods`
:::

## Research {#research}

::: {.section-shell}
::: {.content-shell}
::: {.split-grid}
::: {.stack-block}
### Current Focus

- Robust high-order dynamical low-rank integration near rank deficiency
- Structure-preserving and asymptotic-preserving solvers for kinetic equations
- Reliable reduced models and scientific machine learning
:::

::: {.stack-block}
### Background

<div class="timeline-item">
  <p class="timeline-year">2024–present</p>
  <p class="timeline-text">Pearson Fellow and Acting Instructor in Applied Mathematics at the University of Washington, working with <a href="https://jingweihu-math.github.io/webpage/">Jingwei Hu</a>.</p>
</div>

  <p class="timeline-year">2023</p>
  <p class="timeline-text">Ph.D. in Mathematics, Purdue University, advised by <a href="https://www.math.purdue.edu/~shen7/">Jie Shen</a>.</p>

## Research Software {#software}

::: {.section-shell}
::: {.content-shell}
<p class="section-intro">Open implementations and reproducible experiments accompanying my work in dynamical low-rank approximation, kinetic equations, and structure-preserving optimization.</p>

::: {.software-grid}
::: {.software-item}
### DLRA

A modular Python solver for full and dynamical low-rank simulations of the stiff nonlinear Boltzmann equation, with a command-line interface, tests, and reproducible examples.

::: {.software-links}
[GitHub](https://github.com/shzhang3/DLRA) · [Paper](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S002199912500395X)
:::
:::

::: {.software-item}
### DLR-VPFP

JAX implementations, experiment configurations, and figure-generation scripts for the separable asymptotic-preserving VPFP method.

::: {.software-links}
[GitHub](https://github.com/shzhang3/DLR-VPFP) · [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1051/m2an/2026047)
:::
:::

::: {.software-item}
### RVAV

A PyTorch implementation of the relaxed vector auxiliary variable optimizer, with a drop-in optimizer API, tests, continuous integration, and a quick start.

::: {.software-links}
[GitHub](https://github.com/shzhang3/RVAV) · [Paper](https://epubs.siam.org/doi/10.1137/23M1611087)
:::
:::
:::
:::
:::
